title: Modularize the Manifest Contract
intent: Separate the Work manifest model, serialization, parsing, refs, factories, and invariants
motivation: The manifest contract is central and intentionally strict, but its implementation currently concentrates many unrelated responsibilities in one module. Splitting the contract improves cohesion without introducing a schema dependency or changing the JSON format. Non-goals: no schema version increase unless unavoidable, no Zod or runtime schema framework, no change to manifest authority, no semantic lifecycle change.
ordering: Model and ref naming first, then shared decoding primitives, then the invariant split, then canonical fixtures, then the evolution rules that govern future change. Behavior-preserving throughout.
